# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::combo`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

ComboBox control, on the same four layers as the button (see `button.rs`): a [`ComboLook`](combo.md#struct.ComboLook) and
its settled values, [`paint`](combo.md#fn.paint), the Painter-API [`combo`](combo.md#fn.combo) and [`Ui::combo`](../ui.md#method.Ui.combo). The list itself is
the dropdown's ([`Ui::dropdown`](../ui.md#method.Ui.dropdown)); the combo only asks for it to open.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/combo.rs:1`
